rules: academic_sequence_year 1 maps to cadet fourth class and sequence year 4 maps to cadet first class
each academic sequence year contains three trimesters
fatigue/stress are not standalone Academy meters; Academy references the shared character wellbeing system
relationships use the shared social relationship system
this is an authoring/gameplay contract, not yet a CoreRPG runtime schema
an admitted player cadet occupies one real slot in the Academy population registry
temporary absence from campus does not remove Academy cohort membership
academic group co-membership is not itself a social relationship
materializing a latent cadet preserves slot-based academic group memberships
quarters assignment defines residence but does not guarantee current physical presence
roommate co-residency is shared context and not itself a social relationship
personal schedule is anchored to population_slot_ref and survives latent-to-materialized promotion
schedule expresses expected commitments and locations, not authoritative current physical presence
travel time between different scheduled locations must be feasible or recorded as an explicit schedule conflict
uncommitted timetable intervals are not automatically filled with free-time activities
free-time planning consumes only Step-5 uncommitted intervals and cannot displace required Academy commitments
NPC free-time plans may be selected autonomously from persistent interests/hobbies and real facility capabilities
the player receives feasible free-time choices but no automatic leisure selection
species and player proximity are not free-time selection shortcuts
free-time plan is an intention and not authoritative proof of actual activity or location
Step-6 co-location or public-space use does not itself create social or relationship state
extracurricular membership is persistent slot-first state and survives latent-to-materialized promotion
NPC extracurricular enrollment may use explicit interests/hobbies but not species or player proximity
the player is never automatically enrolled in an extracurricular
extracurricular recurring sessions consume real schedule time and must be travel-feasible
extracurricular membership does not automatically create relationships, capability, grades, wellbeing effects or reputation
formal optional enrichment distinguishes conferences, seminars and additional courses from extracurricular clubs
NPC enrichment registration may use explicit academic interests but not species or player proximity
the player is never automatically registered for optional academic enrichment
every required enrichment session must be presenter-, facility-, timetable- and travel-feasible
registration, attendance and completion are separate states
completion evidence may be produced later but final Academy-record writes remain Step 19
social circles are contextual encounter indexes and do not themselves imply friendship, trust, rivalry or romance
NPC social plans may use explicit social preferences and real shared context but not species, sex category or player proximity
the player is never automatically RSVP'd or assigned a social interaction
social plan, attendance, interaction and relationship state are separate
Step 9 cannot generate romantic or sexual events; Step 10 must obey the locked adult heterosexual relationship canon
Academy romance/dating is adult-equivalent and heterosexual-only under the author-locked project canon
heterosexual compatibility is only an eligibility gate and never creates attraction or interest
the player's romantic interest and consent are never inferred; player romantic actions require explicit player choice
NPC romantic initiation toward the player requires pre-existing authoritative directional romantic-interest state
an accepted invitation does not prove date attendance/completion or relationship commitment
romantic rejection does not automatically create hostility, resentment or disciplinary/social penalty
dates consume real time for both participants and require feasible bilateral travel and venue capability
Step 10 is player-to-NPC/NPC-to-player romance; autonomous NPC-to-NPC evolution remains Step 11
NPC-to-NPC relationship edges are directional, multidimensional, persistent and event-provenance driven
co-location, class membership, club membership and social-circle membership do not automatically create friendship
friendship requires sustained positive shared history; conflict/reconciliation preserves original history
autonomous NPC romance reuses the locked adult heterosexual canon and Step-10 consent/provenance rules
Step-11 autonomous resolver excludes the player and cannot mutate player relationship state
species, materialization state, player proximity and observation are not NPC relationship selectors
instructor assignment, tutoring and mentorship are distinct states even when the same character fills multiple roles
teaching assignment or tutoring does not automatically create mentorship
player mentorship requires explicit player acceptance and may be declined without academic penalty
mentorship is professional context and does not itself create friendship, romance, grades, qualifications or discipline
mentor capacity, professional scope, authority and bilateral schedule/travel feasibility are real constraints
mentor recommendations require evidence and authority but never guarantee grades, qualifications or future assignments
Academy mentorship history persists after graduation but active post-Academy mentorship requires a new valid assignment
Academy wellbeing consumes confirmed actual activity rather than planned activity
wellbeing uses acute, weekly and monthly observation windows rather than one universal meter
individual explicit wellbeing profiles define sleep/load/recovery context; species_id alone is not a wellbeing rule
balanced wellbeing preserves normal capacity and never grants superhuman competence
wellbeing may alter character-side assistance/readiness but never authoritative World Truth
player dialogue/actions are never forced by fatigue, stress or balance state
Step 13 produces no formal academic, disciplinary or obligation consequence; those remain Step 14
